root_cause_criterion.description: Before computing len = coap_opt_length(opt) for an option whose length nibble uses extension bytes, next_option_safe(&opt, &length, &pdu->max_opt) must succeed on that same option. A zero return means the remaining length bytes do not contain a complete option encoding.

nodes.description: At the crash site, the second option-length extension-byte read runs with opt already beyond the caller's remaining-option bound opt + length.

edges.description: The caller's remaining-option bound opt + length is the same bound compared against the sink read pointer inside coap_opt_length.
